must_mention.point: A Preflight script instead of the LLM filter, because deduplication needs memory across events
must_mention.evidence_quote: a script is better than the LLM filter here, because the filter has no memory of earlier events and deduplication needs that

must_mention.point: STATE_FILE plus item id paygate:event_id with version = replay_seq, so a manual replay counts as a new occurrence
must_mention.evidence_quote: The item id is paygate plus the event id, and the version is the replay number

must_mention.point: Transient retries and recoveries are skipped; the final attempt or a non-retryable signature failure goes through
must_mention.evidence_quote: skips retries until the last attempt and skips recoveries, and a signature failure goes straight through

must_mention.point: Timeout set within 1–300 s; a timeout, non-zero exit or invalid output stops the event with no automatic retry
